title: Aichivirus Real-Time RT-PCR Method
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z3tf8nn
materials: SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit
Reagents SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit Life Technologies Catalog #11732088

steps.title: Prepare master mix and dispense
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix for a total reaction volume of 20 µL per well, making enough for the required number of reactions plus a dead volume of typically 2 extra reactions; adjust volumes if using a robotic dispenser. Dispense 15 µL of the master mix into each well of a 100‑place rotor disc (Rotor‑Gene 6000/Rotary‑Gene Q 5‑plex) or the appropriate plate for the ABI 7500 Fast instrument.

substeps.instruction: Calculate master‑mix volume = (number of reactions + 2) × 15 µL.
If using a robotic dispenser, modify the calculated volume according to the dispenser’s dead‑volume requirements.
Dispense 15 µL master mix into each reaction well.

steps.title: Add template and controls
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of extracted RNA template, positive control, or a no‑template control (NTC, nuclease‑free water) to each well, bringing the total volume to 20 µL.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL of the appropriate sample (RNA, control, or NTC) into each well containing the 15 µL master mix.

steps.title: Run real‑time PCR
steps.instruction: Place the reaction plate or rotor disc into the chosen real‑time PCR instrument (Rotor‑Gene 6000/Rotary‑Gene Q 5‑plex or ABI 7500 Fast) and run the assay using the validated cycling program.

steps.title: Analyze amplification results
steps.instruction: Interpret the fluorescence curves: a satisfactory positive result shows a sigmoidal curve with an early threshold (C_T) crossing in the log‑linear phase, a fluorescence intensity comparable to the positive control, and a clear plateau. Any reaction with C_T > 40 cycles is considered negative. No‑template controls must not produce a curve.

substeps.instruction: Confirm the curve is sigmoidal (horizontal baseline, exponential rise, plateau).
Check that fluorescence intensity exceeds the predefined threshold and is similar to the positive control.
Record the C_T value; if C_T ≤ 40 and meets the above criteria, call the sample positive.
Verify NTC wells show no amplification curve.
